role: fixed viewed-data marginalization experiment; no held-out or driving claim
window: first + newest2 selected keys + latest accepted + current, deduplicated, at most5
source_geometry: same raw depth pyramid and newer-to-older Huber point-to-plane factors as joint-keyframe-depth-v1
prior: derived from previous prior plus finest-scale currently supported raw factors incident to eliminated nodes only
elimination: scaled Cholesky solve of removed principal block; Schur Hkk-Hke Hee^-1 Hek and gk-Hke Hee^-1 ge, no inversion/damping/rank filling
no_double_counting: retained-retained raw factors excluded from elimination; consumed pair identities unique and cannot become active again
prior_chart: left retraction delta: w=Log(R R_anchor^T); v=t-Exp(w)t_anchor; exact analytic chart Jacobian; first pose excluded
prior_transport: J^T H J, J^T(H delta +g); Gauss-Newton, not full second-derivative Hessian
nonlinear_relinearization: marginal factors remain frozen at elimination; raw active factors recomputed; no global smoothing
failure_atomic: fit and marginalization must both succeed before committing pose/reference/prior/accepted clock; expiry terminal
control: discard uses same fitter, gates and policy with no retained prior; final SPD admission shared by both
input: original180 selected depth images only; RGB not decoded; numeric labels only after all4 operational branches and raw/state audits
known_limitations: fixed linearized marginal factors, data association/noise/calibration not solved; prior not calibrated uncertainty
